Agriculture and rural development

Honey

The EU is the world's second largest honey producer after China. Honey is covered by the common organisation of markets and by the Honey Directive (Directive 2001/110/EC), see also honey marketing standards.

Market situation

The Commission regularly presents the honey market situation to stakeholders. See the market presentation on honey (autumn 2024) and the minutes of the civil dialogue group meeting of 8 October 2024.
